units.source_text: 熟悉五山文学①的人，无疑还会记得康安元年石室善玖进京都万寿寺时解说佛法的妙语的事。

en.t: Those familiar with Gozan literature will no doubt remember the witty words with which Sekishitsu Zenkyu expounded the Buddhist law when he entered Manjuji Temple in Kyoto in the first year of Koan.

units.source_text: 新任住持就职时，是从山门经由佛殿、土地堂，最后步入方丈室，每经一处都留下了解释佛法的妙语。

en.t: When a newly appointed abbot took office, he would proceed from the temple gate through the Buddha hall and the tutelary shrine, and finally enter the abbot's quarters, leaving at each place a witty saying that explained the Buddhist law.
